reason: True 1.65 Prima quests: classic quests the Prima guides list that the server lacked (2026-11-02)

rows.Name: Rasczel's Bane
rows.StepText: A hobyah bit the nose off your trainer's dog. Bring back the nose of the hobyah leader Rasczel.|Bring the nose to your trainer.

rows.Name: Bear Skins
rows.Description: Bring me the hide of a [mauler] cub and I will pay you well.
rows.StepText: Bring Helen the hide of a black mauler cub from outside Haggerfel.|Return the skin to Helen in Haggerfel.

rows.Name: Big Paw
rows.Description: They say a bear called Big Paw rules Skona [Ravine] like a king. Would you put him to rest?
rows.StepText: Find Big Paw in Skona Ravine, west of Varulvhamn, and slay him.

rows.Name: Trapper's Joy
rows.Description: Wariel was pleased with your [trapping]. She has one more easy task for you.
rows.StepText: See Wariel in Galplen; she has a treated pelt for you to sell.|Take the treated pelt to Kaiti, next to the dye merchants in Galplen.

rows.Name: Trapper's Joy
rows.Description: Wariel was pleased with your [trapping]. She has one more easy task for you.
rows.StepText: See Wariel in Galplen; she has a treated pelt for you to sell.|Take the treated pelt to Kaiti, next to the dye merchants in Galplen.

rows.Name: Ghoul Hair Belt
rows.Description: I can make a magical belt from ghoul hair. Bring me a patch of [decayed] hair and the belt is yours.
rows.StepText: Wayward ghouls walk north of Audliten at night; bring Lefur a patch of their decayed hair.|Give the hair to Lefur in Audliten.

rows.Name: Missing Bard
rows.Description: The bard [O'Rourke] has gone missing. Ask Maire at the Connla bridge what became of him.
rows.StepText: Speak with Maire on the north shore by the Connla bridge.|Find O'Rourke in the ollipheist valley.|Slay the ollipheist Arracht and take back O'Rourke's flute.|Give the flute to Maire in Connla.|Return to Illaliel in Ardagh and tell her O'Rourke is fine. (whisper: O'Rourke is fine)

rows.Name: Growler Mace
rows.Description: Sergeant Alain has a long errand for those who slew Growler: the [shipment] of etched rods, and a mace made from it.
rows.TargetName: Cyfwlch Difwych;1|Beria, apprentice smith;1|Contyth, Apprentice Smith;1|Mathien;1||ghost miner;1|Mathien;1|Guards' Armorer;1|Mathien;1
rows.StepText: Get the shipment of etched rods from the bandit Cyfwlch Difwych at his camp on the road to Castle Sauvage.|Take the rods to Beria, apprentice smith, in West Downs.|Beria sends her work on to Contyth, Apprentice Smith, in Humberton.|Contyth sends you to his father Mathien, by the bind stone at Snowdonia Station.|Mathien needs metal before he can work: do Mathien's Metal for him.|Mathien needs a hunk of ore to finish the mace: take one from the ghost miners on the hill northwest of Snowdonia Station, below Swanton Keep.|Bring the ore to Mathien.|Mathien sends you to the Guards' Armorer in Swanton Keep.|Return to Mathien for your mace.

rows.Name: Mathien's Metal
rows.Description: Mathien needs metal for his work, and the trader Erick [Redbeard] is in the way.
rows.StepText: Find Erick Redbeard with the red dwarf matrons in the vale due west of Snowdonia Station, and slay him.|Return to Mathien at Snowdonia Station.
